name: Dumbbell Seated Single-Leg Calf Raise
steps: Sit upright on a bench and steady a dumbbell on one thigh just above the knee with that foot flat.
Press firmly through the ball of the loaded foot to lift your heel as high as comfortable.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower your heel back to the floor under control.
Move the dumbbell to your other thigh and switch legs.
tips: Keep the dumbbell off the kneecap and your toes pointing straight forward.
Move smoothly through your full ankle range without bouncing at the bottom.
